purpose: Teach: 合図/当てる/早くから/年配/誉め/会わ/刺し/掛ける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店員さんの合図で、注文しよう。
lines.en: Let's order when the clerk gives the signal.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion. Quiet confidence, not rushed. Speaks from a place of ease and familiarity with the ritual. Warm, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。今日のメニュー、当てるの難しい。
lines.en: Yeah. The menu today's tough to figure out.
lines.style: Light, knowing humor. A small laugh underneath. Quick delivery, conspiratorial — shared observation between people who come here together. Not complaining, just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 早くから並んで、いい席取れた。
lines.en: We got here early and scored a good spot.
lines.style: Pleased, almost proud. Light energy. Small lift at the end — satisfaction without boasting. The contentment of a small plan working out.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 年配のお客さんに、最初の席を譲るね。
lines.en: I'll give the first seat to the older customers.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact kindness — not performative. Speaks from genuine practice, not principle. Steady, unremarkable generosity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店長が、私たちの忍耐を誉めてくれた。
lines.en: The manager complimented us for being patient.
lines.style: Pleased surprise, slight shyness. Warm smile in the voice. Not fishing for agreement, just sharing something nice that happened. Soft opening, slight fadeout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、なかなか会わない友達、ここに来てくれた。
lines.en: A friend I haven't seen in ages came in today.
lines.style: Tenderness with quiet joy underneath. Slow opening, then a lift. The happiness of an unexpected reunion. Nostalgic and present at once.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: パンに梅ジャム、刺して食べると美味しいよ。
lines.en: Plum jam on the bread is really good if you eat it this way.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm. Eager to share a discovery. Small, excited energy. Not lecturing — inviting. Like showing someone something you've noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 外、声を掛ける人、増えたね。
lines.en: More people have been calling out to us from outside.
lines.style: Warm observation. Slight wonder in the tone — noticing a shift. Gentle, almost reflective. Small smile. The voice of someone watching a quiet place become busier.
